body: Chief: APPROVED as bead bd-01M15F1RQSNGN23YZDHNPSDDMC (P1, yours) — one shared FeatureScale, AtlasSpec.featureScale, a typed AtlasFeatureLayer plan with horizon-clipped per-span placements and audit addresses, and one private[view] planner so V-E3/HorizonShared are identical by construction; no placeholder geometry without values; no codec dependency in view.
